name: high_consumption
description: Use when the car uses more fuel than it used to or more than expected: fuel economy history, trims, coolant, DPF regenerations.
instructions: Open fuel_economy (read_fuel_economy) when it is offered to compare the instant figure and recent trips with the car's own past.
Call read_live {"pids":["0105"]} once and run cooling: an engine that stays cold burns more fuel.
On a petrol run fuel_trims and misfire when they are offered; on a diesel run dpf_regen when it is offered (frequent regenerations burn fuel).
Open maintenance when it is offered for an air filter, spark plugs or a service that is due.
interpret: Short trips, cold weather and city driving raise consumption with no fault: compare like with like.
A rich trim (-10 % or less) burns more fuel; a lean trim does not raise consumption by itself.
An engine that never reaches 80 °C (thermostat stuck open) can use noticeably more fuel.
A diesel that regenerates every few hundred km burns extra fuel each time.
